one_off_receipts.what: Sale of New Jersey NOL tax benefits under NJEDA Program, received April 2020
one_off_receipts.quote: In April 2020, we received approximately $5,200,000, net of expenses, from the sale of most of our remaining unused New Jersey NOL eligible for sale under the NJEDA Program.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 784,321 shares in October 2020
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: During October 2020, the Company sold an aggregate of 784,321 shares of its common stock under the ATM program and realized net proceeds of approximately $4.6 million.

warrants.quote: As of September 30, 2020, there were 183,148 outstanding warrants with a weighted average exercise price of $4.96 per share and a weighted average remaining contractual life of 1.86 years.
